witness_description: Take x=(0,0,...) and y=(1,1,...). For every positive integer N, the Nth partial sum is N, so the displayed series diverges.
refutation_explanation: Both constant endpoint sequences lie in the Hilbert cube I^ω, but the displayed unweighted sum is not finite for this pair. Its square root therefore is not a real-valued distance, so the formula does not define a metric on all of I^ω.
search_space: All 4 ordered pairs (x,y) of constant endpoint sequences x_k=a and y_k=b with (a,b) in {0,1}^2. For each pair, divergence was decided exactly from the identity S_N=N(a-b)^2; the complete four-pair space was swept in fixed lexicographic order.
